requiredCarryOvers.description: User-requested sing-box built-in replacement from open PR #49; not yet part of main or this source bundle. Must be included and tested before promoting 139.

constraints: Do not restore successful core-version result caching; query live on each details opening.
Keep upstream 139 implementations; do not overwrite methods/classes with 134 bodies.
Preserve existing databases/configurations; do not silently use an empty fallback database.
Do not add recursive chmod/chown or disable SELinux for the previously diagnosed directory-owner mismatch.
Do not publish a partial feature set or merge merely because the vanilla/134 builds pass.
remainingBlockers: Review all type/member bindings, including field initialization semantics and class splits.
Port changed/ambiguous integration methods and constructors without replacing new upstream logic.
Apply the pending user configuration replacement from PR #49.
Stage all eight features, run actual 139 custom reference/assembly/behavior/preservation tests, then build/sign/verify the candidate APK.
Review the completed PR and obtain the required device/upgrade test results before merging.
